ev.q: Among eligible HCP, 37 (43%) received PEP, including 10 (50%) with high-risk exposures and 27 (40%) with intermediate-risk exposures.
Among 313 Colorado HCP exposed to patients with monkeypox, recommended PPE use and receipt of postexposure prophylaxis vaccination was low.
Overall, 273 (87%) exposures to patients with monkeypox rash or lesions occurred
Adherence to all recommended PPE ranged from 4% in primary and urgent care settings to 48% in community health and STI clinics.
Clinical staff members reported higher PPE use than did nonclinical staff members
PPE use varied by facility type:
CDPHE collected data on clinical and nonclinical HCP exposed by treating, being within 6 feet of, or handling linens

methods_quotes.q: These data were summarized and stratified by facility type and job title.
Analyses were completed using R statistical software (version 2021.09.2; The R Foundation).
risk levels were assigned using the CDC HCP risk assessment criteria at the time (low or uncertain, intermediate, or high).
